title: Open Letter to the Board
body:
Add your notes via comments to this document:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1me7kLskEry7tjQGGshNSF73xxHs3874OfZNQJrBWXO0/edit

Currently we are looking into reframing the letter to be addressed more towards the founder of the school.

title: Ketchup on 2 December 13:00
body:
Please prepare your questions ahead of time, formulate them, and write them down. We will be recording the answers in writing.

Alternatively, use this form: https://forms.gle/qd155buBUckpLwpu6

The questions will NOT be shared with the leadership team before the ketchup.

title: Latest news recap
body:
* The card for one of the beloved members of the staff can be signed on Thursday or Friday and will be sent out next week.

* Our facility manager would like to express his enormous gratitude to the student community. He feels supported, and it warms his heart. He says to please continue the fight.

* On 26 Nov there will be another discussion between students and a member of the leadership team. One of the main questions to ask is why hiring is happening when in the last ketchup it was publicly said that there are no open positions?

* We will be addressing the Employee Insurance Agency (UWV) to revert or positively affect the decisions made by the leadership team.

* The leadership team asked us to compile and share a list of concrete questions. But students prefer to ask questions in person and ad-hoc style.

title: Extra 7 days for everyone
body: From our Education lead via Slack: “…everyone will receive a 7-day extension to their deadline. This is applied automatically throughout the day.”

title: Hiring new people VS what was said during Ketchup
body:
The results of a conversation with a member of the leadership team regarding the hiring of a marketer when it was previously said that the management is currently not hiring anyone.

1. They admitted that they are indeed hiring someone for a marketing position, and probably will hire “a couple of interns in the next year”. The roles of the three employees being fired are considered redundant and won’t be fulfilled or re-hired. Other details were promised to be shared next week during ketchup meeting.

2. We disagreed on the point of sharing student questions beforehand. They said that they will respond only to the questions they can find on Slack, and any other ad-hoc questions will not be answered or will be reserved for later. We expressed that students expect them to be able to answer any question after all the internal discussions they will have on Monday.

3. We disagreed on the point of what exactly was said during the previous ketchup about hiring new people. The majority of the students say they heard “we are not hiring new people”, which corresponds to the notes taken by one of the students. The leadership team insists that the student body misinterpreted the words.

title: Student Forum on Monday, 30 November at 13:00
body:
On Monday 30 November let's gather together, STUDENTS ONLY, to share our questions, have a discussion, align on our priorities and prepare questions for the ketchup meeting on 2 Dec.

There will be a moderator, so everyone, in turn, has a chance to speak up and be heard. All the questions will be noted down and saved.

The forum will start at 13:00 and is expected to take about 2 to 3 hours. There will be a shared lunch and soft drinks, and one or two breaks during the forum.
